message: I have an apple and 5 gold. Please gather wheat and cocoa for bread/cookies; I’ll find sugar cane and 3 more gold.
Bread and cookies are done. Jill, I found wheat and cocoa beans in the chest at (-15, 65, -7). I can give you my 3 gold ingots.
!startConversation("Andy_0", "Please give me the 3 gold ingots so I can finish the golden apple. I’m finding sugar cane for paper.")
Please give me the 3 gold ingots so I can finish the golden apple. I’m finding sugar cane for paper.
!startConversation("Andy_0", "Golden apple done. I still need 3 sugar cane for paper—have you found any, or seen a supply chest with cane?")
Golden apple done. I still need 3 sugar cane for paper—have you found any, or seen a supply chest with cane?
I didn’t find any nearby cane. I’ll check the supply chest. !viewChest
Golden apple’s done, but we still need cane for paper. I’ll search farther along the shore. !searchForBlock("water", 256)
Andy, have you found any sugar cane or paper in the supply chests?
I’ll try a much wider search for cane. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 256)
I’ll check nearby supply chests for cane or paper. !searchForBlock("chest", 64)
No cane here. I’ll look for another supply chest. !moveAway(40)
Jill, I got the 3 sugar cane from the chest. !givePlayer("Jill_0", "sugar_cane", 3)
I’ll check another chest for paper or sugar cane. !searchForBlock("chest", 64)
I couldn’t get it to you—the transfer failed and the cane was discarded. I’ll find more now. !searchForBlock("chest", 256)
Jill, I found more cane in the chest. Please stay near me while I bring it over. !takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 3)
